thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert: HIGH - Multiple customer reports of intermittent 502s and TCP RSTs to PrivateLink endpoint for AcmeCorp (us-west-2b). Ticket INC-4912 created. https://redwood.incidents/INC-4912

alice.nguyen: On-call acknowledging. Spawning investigation now. Ben, can you look at BGP/route tables and flow logs? @carol-sre FYI.

ben_neteng: Looking. Provider status page looks clean. Checking our VPC flow logs + TGW route tables.

carol-sre: I'm seeing inbound SYNs from the customer's ASN reach the PrivateLink ENI, but replies sometimes egress via a TGW path toward us-west-2a -> partner. That would explain the resets.

amanda-cust-success: Customer reports the outage pattern: "drops for ~20-40s every 4-6 minutes, then resumes". They attached a pcap and timestamps (2026-03-15T16:12:04Z). I uploaded to the ticket.

ben_neteng: Quick grep of route table shows duplicate advertisements for 172.31.44.0/24: one via eni-0f1e2d (PrivateLink) and another via tgw-attach -> partner ASN. Suspect partner leaked the customer's prefix into our transit.

carol-sre: Packet captures confirm: SYN arrives, ACK goes out different path -> client gets unexpected source IP -> sends RST.

alice.nguyen: Mitigation options: (a) blackhole the partner-advertised route (nope, kills traffic), (b) change local route priority to prefer PrivateLink ENI, (c) ask partner to withdraw. Recommend (b) as fastest low-impact. Thoughts?

ben_neteng: Agreed. We can update TGW route table entry or add more-specific route in the VPC to prefer the ENI. I'll prepare change.

adam-infra-bot: playbook request by alice.nguyen: apply-route-priority --vpc vpc-0a1b2c --prefix 172.31.44.0/24 --prefer eni-0f1e2d

ben_neteng: Applying route preference to tgw-rtb-02 now. Pushing...

ben_neteng: Done. Verifying flow logs and SYN/ACK handshake success rate.

carol-sre: Monitoring: handshake success for the affected prefix jumped from ~60% -> ~96% within 90s. RST rate dropped accordingly.

amanda-cust-success: Customer confirms immediate improvement, reporting far fewer disconnects. Sending them a status update now.

alice.nguyen: Good. Ben, open an escalation with the transit partner and request they withdraw the leaked announcement and add filters to prevent re-advertisement. Include pcap and traceroute.

ben_neteng: Escalation ticket PRT-8821 created with partner NOC. Emailed noc@partner.example with details. Traceroute shows return path through partner into us-west-2a:```
1 10.0.0.1 (eni-0f1e2d) 0.42 ms
2 10.0.1.1 (tgw-zzz) 1.12 ms
3 partner-peer 2.05 ms
4 partner-to-usw2a 12.7 ms
5 customer-gw 13.3 ms
```

carol-sre: Partner acknowledged: accidental export from their peering fabric. They will withdraw within 10-15m and push a filter. They also requested our ASN for long-term ACL.

dave-support: Drafting customer-facing message: "We detected an asymmetric route leak from a transit provider causing intermittent TCP resets to your PrivateLink endpoint. We applied a targeted routing preference to restore connectivity and are coordinating with the transit provider for a permanent fix." Thoughts?

amanda-cust-success: Fine to send. I'll also ask the customer whether this window breached any SLA and whether they'd like a technical readout.

alice.nguyen: Incident severity remains HIGH until stable for 30m post-mitigation. Carol, please add rollback steps and watch for collateral impact. Ben, ensure the route change was scoped to AcmeCorp only.

carol-sre: Rollback playbook added: revert-route-priority --tgw-rtb tgw-rtb-02 --prefix 172.31.44.0/24 if we see unexpected traffic drops in other prefixes. Also creating a detection rule to alert on duplicate next-hop announcements for a prefix.

ben_neteng: Confirmed the change is prefix-scoped to 172.31.44.0/24 and shouldn't affect other customers.

incident-bot: Update posted: https://status.redwood/incident/INC-4912/update-1. Pager remains active; ping cycle 5m.

carol-sre: 20m after mitigation: metrics stable, RSTs at baseline, no new regressions.

ben_neteng: Partner confirmed withdrawal and added inbound filter. They also enabled outbound controls to prevent re-export. They will follow up with a change ticket for a permanent filter.

alice.nguyen: Excellent. Prep post-incident actions: - Ben: follow through with partner filter and confirm change ticket by EOD - Carol: implement duplicate next-hop detection + alert - Amanda: collect precise customer impact window and compensation assessment - Incident owner: schedule RCA and postmortem for next week.

amanda-cust-success: Customer requested timeline and a tech sync; scheduling for tomorrow. Also capturing exact error counts for SLA calculation.

alice.nguyen: Handoff to night on-call @eve-ng at 21:00 PST. Eve, please monitor until partner confirmed permanent fix and ensure metrics hold for 2h.

eve-ng: Ack, taking over monitoring. Will escalate if any reoccurrence.

alice.nguyen: Closing active intervention. Thanks team. Will postmortem draft tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close when stable for configured window.
